description: DEA controlled substance schedules (21 CFR 1308.11-1308.15, via eCFR): substance name and DEA Controlled Substances Code Number for schedule I to V table entries matching a name. Substances listed only in paragraphs are not searched. Does not include registration status. Up to 20 matches per call. Choose this tool for: DEA controlled substance schedules: substance name and DEA. Close alternatives on this server: health_eu_cosing_cosmetics (EU cosmetics regulatory status for a substance name); health_chEMBL_bioactive_molecules (EMBL-EBI ChEMBL molecule search: ChEMBL ID, preferred name). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
